name: dama
description: Digital Dama board game with real-time multiplayer

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm run install --prefix backend && npm run install --prefix frontend
scripts.clean: rimraf node_modules backend/node_modules frontend/node_modules shared/node_modules backend/dist frontend/dist shared/dist
